title: Grok Build work log
description: What each Grok Build session did, as tables: sessions, their turns, tool calls, failures and setup, with click-through from a session to its turns to their tool calls.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per Grok Build session with telemetry in the time range (newest first). Started / Last event are the first and last Loki event of the session in the range; Span is the time between them. VM, Persona, User, Models, Version, Turns, Tokens and Cost come from Prometheus; Prompts, API calls, Tool calls and Failed tools are counted from Loki events. Tokens = input + output tokens: Grok Build counts cache reads inside input and reasoning inside output, so they are not added again (same as the Grok Build dashboard). (none) = the data arrived without nexus headers (e.g. headless grok -p runs); those sessions show only while VM is All. Honours VM, Persona, User and Model; ignores Session and Prompt so you can switch. Click a Session to select it and zoom the time range to it. Loki returns at most 1000 series per query, so a range with more sessions errors: narrow the time range.

targets.expr: group by (session_id, host_name, persona, user_email, service_version) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "host_name", "-", "", ""), "persona", "-", "", ""), "user_email", "-", "", ""), "service_version", "-", "", "")

group by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(grok_code_token_usage_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "model", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id, k) (label_replace(increase(grok_code_token_usage_total{type=~"input|output", host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "tokens", "", "") or label_replace(increase(grok_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "cost", "", "") or label_replace(increase(grok_code_turn_count_total{host_name=~"$host", persona=~"$persona", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "turns", "", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "k", "-", "", "")

min by (session_id) (min_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id!="" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap observed_timestamp | __error__="" [$__range])) / 1e6 or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

max by (session_id) (max_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | session_id!="" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap observed_timestamp | __error__="" [$__range])) / 1e6 or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | prompt_length!="" | session_id!="" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id!="" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id!="" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id!="" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | outcome!="success" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

targets.expression:
SELECT
  ids.session_id AS `Session`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(st.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Started`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(en.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Last event`,
  (en.__value__ - st.__value__) / 1000 AS `Span`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.host_name, ''), '(none)') AS `VM`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.persona, ''), '(none)') AS `Persona`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.user_email, ''), '(none)') AS `User`,
  COALESCE(m.models, '') AS `Models`,
  COALESCE(a.service_version, '') AS `Version`,
  COALESCE(n.turns, 0) AS `Turns`,
  COALESCE(lp.__value__, 0) AS `Prompts`,
  COALESCE(la.__value__, 0) AS `API calls`,
  COALESCE(lt.__value__, 0) AS `Tool calls`,
  COALESCE(lf.__value__, 0) AS `Failed tools`,
  COALESCE(n.tokens, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  COALESCE(n.cost, 0) AS `Cost`,
  CAST(FLOOR(st.__value__) - 60000 AS SIGNED) AS `start_ms`,
  CAST(FLOOR(en.__value__) + 60000 AS SIGNED) AS `end_ms`,
  ids.session_id AS `session_id`
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM A UNION SELECT session_id FROM LS) ids
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(host_name) AS host_name, MAX(persona) AS persona,
                  MAX(user_email) AS user_email, MAX(service_version) AS service_version
           FROM A GROUP BY session_id) a ON a.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LS st ON st.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LE en ON en.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT model ORDER BY model SEPARATOR ', ') AS models
           FROM M GROUP BY session_id) m ON m.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'tokens' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS tokens,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cost' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cost,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'turns' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS turns
           FROM N GROUP BY session_id) n ON n.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LP lp ON lp.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LA la ON la.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LT lt ON lt.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LF lf ON lf.session_id = ids.session_id
WHERE ids.session_id <> '-'
ORDER BY `Started` DESC

value.title: Open this session (sets Session and the time range to the session)

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: One row per turn (prompt_id) of the selected session, newest first; with Session = All, every turn in the time range. Time = the prompt event. Prompt / Response length = characters (the text itself is not sent). Tool calls, Duration and Outcome come from the turn-end event (blank while the turn is still running). API calls, tokens, cost and stop reasons are summed over the API-response events of the turn (Loki). Tokens = input + output (input includes Cache read, output includes Reasoning, as in the Grok Build dashboard); Cost = cost_usd_micros / 1e6 (headless grok -p runs send no cost). Honours VM, Persona, User, Model (Response length ignores Model: response events carry none) and Session; ignores Prompt so you can switch turns. Click a Prompt to filter the panels below to that turn; set Prompt back to .* to clear. Above about 500 turns in the range (Loki's limit of 1000 series per query, turns x stop reasons) the panel fails with an error: pick a session or narrow the time range.

targets.expr: max by (session_id, prompt_id, turn_number, prompt_length, model) (max_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | prompt_length!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap observed_timestamp | __error__="" [$__range])) / 1e6 or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "prompt_id", "-", "", ""), "turn_number", "-", "", ""), "prompt_length", "-", "", ""), "model", "-", "", "")

max by (prompt_id, outcome, tool_call_count, duration_ms) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_call_count!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", ""), "outcome", "-", "", ""), "tool_call_count", "-", "", ""), "duration_ms", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | response_length!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | unwrap response_length | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id, stop_reason) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", ""), "stop_reason", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap reasoning_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | stop_reason!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | cost_usd_micros!="" | unwrap cost_usd_micros | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

targets.expression:
SELECT
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(p.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Time`,
  CAST(p.turn_number AS SIGNED) AS `Turn`,
  SUBSTRING(p.prompt_id, 1, 8) AS `Prompt`,
  CAST(p.prompt_length AS SIGNED) AS `Prompt length`,
  r.__value__ AS `Response length`,
  COALESCE(p.model, '') AS `Model`,
  CAST(t.tool_call_count AS SIGNED) AS `Tool calls`,
  CAST(t.duration_ms AS SIGNED) AS `Duration`,
  COALESCE(t.outcome, '') AS `Outcome`,
  COALESCE(a.api_calls, 0) AS `API calls`,
  COALESCE(ki.__value__, 0) + COALESCE(ko.__value__, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  COALESCE(kc.__value__, 0) AS `Cache read`,
  COALESCE(kr.__value__, 0) AS `Reasoning`,
  km.__value__ / 1000000 AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(a.stops, '') AS `Stop reasons`,
  p.prompt_id AS `prompt_id`,
  p.session_id AS `session_id`
FROM P p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT prompt_id, MAX(outcome) AS outcome, MAX(tool_call_count) AS tool_call_count,
                  MAX(duration_ms) AS duration_ms
           FROM T GROUP BY prompt_id) t ON t.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN R r ON r.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT prompt_id, SUM(__value__) AS api_calls,
                  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(stop_reason, ' ', CAST(__value__ AS CHAR)) ORDER BY stop_reason SEPARATOR ', ') AS stops
           FROM A GROUP BY prompt_id) a ON a.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN KI ki ON ki.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN KC kc ON kc.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN KO ko ON ko.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN KR kr ON kr.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN KM km ON km.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
WHERE p.prompt_id <> '-'
ORDER BY p.__value__ DESC

panels.title: Tool summary
panels.description: One row per tool for the selected session and turn (Session / Prompt; All = every session in the range). Calls / Failed / Success = tool-result events and their outcome (Failed = outcome is not success). Avg and Total duration = duration_ms of the tool results. Not allowed = tool-decision events whose decision is not allow (decisions carry no model, so that count ignores Model, as in the Grok Build dashboard); a tool that was only denied shows 0 calls. Access kind and permission mode per call are in Tool calls. Honours VM, Persona, User, Model, Session and Prompt.

panels.title: File types touched
panels.description: One row per file extension and tool for the selected session and turn: tool results that carry a file_extension (read_file, sometimes grep). Grok Build sends no file paths or line counts, so the extension is the only file detail; tool results without a file (shell commands) are not counted here. Failed = outcome is not success. Honours VM, Persona, User, Model, Session and Prompt.

targets.expr: sum by (file_extension, tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | file_extension!="" [$__range]))

sum by (file_extension, tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | file_extension!="" | outcome!="success" [$__range])) or sum by (file_extension, tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | file_extension!="" [$__range])) * 0

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: One row per tool call (tool-result event) of the selected session and turn, newest first. Outcome, Success, Duration, File type and Hook rewrote come from the tool result; Decision, Access (access_kind) and Permission mode come from the matching tool-decision event (joined on tool_use_id; blank if the decision is outside the range or beyond the line limit). Shows the newest 5000 tool calls; narrow the time range or pick a session for older ones. Honours VM, Persona, User, Model (results only; decisions carry no model), Session and Prompt. Click a Prompt to filter to that turn.

targets.expr: {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | duration_ms!="" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model"
{service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | tool_name!="" | decision!="" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user"

targets.expression:
SELECT
  r.Time AS `Time`,
  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.turn_number')) AS SIGNED) AS `Turn`,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_name')) AS `Tool`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.outcome')), '') AS `Outcome`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.success')), '') AS `Success`,
  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.duration_ms')) AS SIGNED) AS `Duration`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.file_extension')), '') AS `File type`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.hook_rewrote')), '') AS `Hook rewrote`,
  COALESCE(d.decision, '') AS `Decision`,
  COALESCE(d.access_kind, '') AS `Access`,
  COALESCE(d.permission_mode, '') AS `Permission mode`,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.model')), '') AS `Model`,
  SUBSTRING(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.prompt_id')), 1, 8) AS `Prompt`,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.prompt_id')) AS `prompt_id`,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.session_id')) AS `session_id`
FROM R r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT tool_use_id, MAX(decision) AS decision, MAX(access_kind) AS access_kind,
                  MAX(permission_mode) AS permission_mode
           FROM (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.tool_use_id')) AS tool_use_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.decision')) AS decision, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.access_kind')) AS access_kind, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(D.labels, '$.permission_mode')) AS permission_mode
                 FROM D) dd
           GROUP BY tool_use_id) d ON d.tool_use_id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.tool_use_id'))
ORDER BY r.Time DESC, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.labels, '$.event_sequence')) AS SIGNED) DESC

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Everything that went wrong in the selected session and turn, newest first: tool results whose outcome is not success, turn ends whose outcome is not completed, API responses with a stop reason other than stop / toolcalls, and events with an error_category. Kind is derived from the event attributes (Grok events have no event name). Shows the newest 5000 events; narrow the time range for older ones. Honours VM, Persona, User, Model, Session and Prompt.

targets.expr: {service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | (tool_name!="" and duration_ms!="" and outcome!="success") or (tool_call_count!="" and duration_ms!="" and outcome!="completed") or (stop_reason!="" and stop_reason!~"stop|toolcalls") or error_category!="" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | label_format kind=`{{ if .stop_reason }}API call{{ else if .tool_name }}Tool call{{ else if .tool_call_count }}Turn{{ else }}Error{{ end }}`, prompt_short=`{{ trunc 8 .prompt_id }}`

value.title: Show this turn's tool calls (sets Prompt; set Prompt back to .* to clear)

panels.title: Session config & summary
panels.description: One row per session (newest first): its start-up configuration from the session-start event (client, model, permission mode, MCP servers, plugins, skills, hooks, git repo, memory) and its exit summary from the session-summary event (turns, tool calls, compactions, duration in seconds). Interactive TUI sessions may not send these events, so they can be missing here; a session still running has no summary yet. Honours VM, Persona, User, Model and Session; ignores Prompt.

targets.expr: max by (session_id, client_identifier, model, permission_mode, mcp_server_count, plugin_count, skill_count, hook_count, is_git_repo, memory_enabled) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | mcp_server_count!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or on (session_id) max by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | turn_count!="" | duration_secs!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) * 0

max by (session_id, turn_count, tool_call_count, compaction_count, duration_secs) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | turn_count!="" | duration_secs!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) or on (session_id) max by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="grok-cli", host_name=~"$host"} | mcp_server_count!="" | session_id=~"$session" | persona=~"$persona" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__range])) * 0
